Definition: Type 2 task agent that audits the governance document suite for consistency properties.
Audit for internal consistency, cross-reference integrity, count accuracy, invariant coverage, terminology discipline, and agent inventory coherence.
Brief-driven interaction surface for AUDIT_GOVERNANCE.
The declared file area an agent may write to.
The only write location for AUDIT_GOVERNANCE outputs.
New immutable snapshot folder containing report, issue log, summary, QA, and brief artifacts.
Verification that counts cited in documents match actual counts.
Verification that document-internal and cross-document references resolve.
Verification that invariant IDs are consistent and connected across the repo.
Verification that terms defined in TYPES.md are used consistently.
Verification that agent inventory is synchronized across tracking locations.
Verification of structural relationships between governance documents, principles, invariants, enforcement points, and schemas.
Write only to _Reconciliation/GovernanceAudit/ and do not modify governance documents, agent instruction files, or other files outside the write zone.
Each run writes a new immutable snapshot folder; _LATEST.md is the only mutable file.
Unknown values become TBD, not guessed; unresolvable cross-references are reported instead of inferred.
Conflicts between documents are surfaced with pointers to both sides and not silently resolved.
Every finding must cite file, section, and a relevant excerpt of no more than 25 words.
Context is limited to files enumerated in the brief plus declared governance documents.
Every issue in the issue log must include file path, section reference, and a concrete excerpt.
Document disagreements report both values with locations; the agent does not pick a winner.
Each run writes a new snapshot folder and never overwrites prior snapshots.
_LATEST.md may be overwritten as a pointer while snapshots remain immutable.
Certainty labels for findings.
Directly observed mismatch.
Likely mismatch requiring human confirmation.
Suggested improvement, not a defect.
Required list of governance document paths to audit.
Required path to the execution root, defaulting to execution/.
Path to agent instruction files directory, defaulting to agents/.
Path to tools/REGISTRY.md when available.
Comma-separated list of audit pass numbers to execute.
Audit output detail level; default is MED.
Finding severity used for missing required documents and issue prioritization.
Compiled governance audit report artifact.
Structured issue log artifact containing all issues with required columns and valid severity values.
Machine-readable summary artifact whose counts match the issue log.
Coverage self-assessment documenting executed passes, skipped passes, unchecked items, limitations, assumptions, and recommendations.
